verdict.rationale: Datalab offers Enterprise on-prem/air-gapped deployment so customers can run models on infrastructure they control (implying residency control), and Team plan includes BAA/DPA for compliance, but there is no documented cloud-tier region-selection feature (e.g., choosing US/EU data center) for standard SaaS usage. missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selector for standard cloud accounts, independent confirmation of on-prem residency guarantees.
